description: This file defines the class 'OpenAIImageVariationsHandler' responsible for handling image variation requests using the OpenAI API, including both synchronous and asynchronous methods for interacting with the API, transforming requests and responses, and managing error handling. It contains methods to configure API clients, perform image variation operations, and integrate with a logging system.
